## Professional identity

Musa DİVARCI is a Senior Software Developer and Technology Leader with professional software engineering experience since 2001.

His core software expertise is centered on Microsoft technologies, .NET and C#, backend architecture, ASP.NET Core, Clean Architecture, web applications and database-driven systems (SQL). His broader technical background includes Python, TypeScript, React, information technologies, system engineering, network architecture, Cisco networking and enterprise IT.

Python is utilized for automation, data processing, backend utilities and developer tooling. TypeScript and React represent modern frontend and product-development work.

Within Türkiye's Ministry of National Education (MEB), his professional technology identity is centered on Bilişim Teknolojileri Koordinatörlüğü (Information Technologies Coordination) and IT expertise. An archived official Çorum Provincial Directorate of National Education BİM page identifies Musa DİVARCI as “BT Koordinatörü”.

## Selected public engineering projects

- Plex — Distributed Operations & Audit Platform
  .NET / C# backend architecture, ASP.NET Core, Clean Architecture, worker services and audit-oriented domain design.
  https://github.com/musadivarci/PlexV1

- Aegis — Knowledge & Workflow Automation Engine
  Information architecture, structured data workflows, TypeScript and Python data processing tools.
  https://github.com/musadivarci/aegis

- wondR — Personal Learning OS
  React, TypeScript and Supabase learning and knowledge retention application.
  https://github.com/musadivarci/wondr

  https://web.archive.org/web/20190402035623/http://corum.meb.gov.tr/bim/destek.html

  https://www.yaylahaber.com.tr/dyned-ilce-sorumlulari-toplantisi-yapildi

  https://www.memurlar.net/haber/140957/cubukcu-dan-3-yilda-100-temel-eser-projesine-tam-not.html

## Identity note

Musa DİVARCI, Musa Divarcı and Musa Divarci refer to the same person. The LinkedIn profile at linkedin.com/in/musa-divarci-9280515a, GitHub profile at github.com/musadivarci and Medium profile at medium.com/@musadivarci19 are connected public professional and technical identities for the same entity.
